provenance: Pre-authored spatial rider track for the controlled recorded Demo footage. Hand-read annotation, not detector output: it is not live detection, AI inference, Jetson tracking, or Core Rider Lock.
coordinateSystem: normalized SOURCE-frame coordinates, origin top-left; cx, cy = box centre, w, h = box size, all 0..1

keyframeSemantics.visible: rider seen; interpolated to the next visible keyframe
keyframeSemantics.occluded: rider not seen; the box is the last-known position and is held until the next keyframe
keyframeSemantics.unknown: no rider position known; no box
